premise: Owl wakes up hooting squeaks; Mouse lends his squeak, Deer lends a low hum, and their silly noises together make Owl laugh his own hoot back.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop) and folk voice-swap tales, turned: the smallest and the tallest lend the wise one their voices, and laughter is the cure.
lesson: Laughing with friends brings back what worry took away.

en-US.title: Owl Loses His Hoot
en-US.text: {canvas:night 0.5 90s} One evening Owl {owl:pulse} woke up, stretched his wings, and opened his beak to say hoo. [surprised] {sfx:squeak} Squeak! Owl blinked. He tried again. Squeak! [sad] Oh no, said Owl. My hoot is gone. Mouse {mouse:hop} climbed up the tree. {tree:pulse} Do not worry, he said. You can borrow mine. Squeak-squeak! Deer {deer:pulse} lifted his big head. And mine, he said, very low. Hmmmm. Owl tried both at once. Squeak-hmmm. Mouse tried. Hmmm-squeak. Deer tried and sounded like a bumblebee with a cold. {deer:wobble} [laughs] Owl began to laugh. Mouse laughed. Deer laughed so hard the tree {tree:wobble x2} shook its leaves. And out of the middle of Owl's laugh, big and round and warm, came… {sfx:hoot} HOO! {owl:hop} {owl:sparkle} There it is! said Mouse. [softly] It was hiding behind a giggle, said Deer. And Owl hooted all night long, just to be sure.

es-ES.title: Búho pierde su uuuh
es-ES.text: {canvas:night 0.5 90s} Una tarde, Búho {owl:pulse} se despertó, estiró las alas y abrió el pico para decir uuuh. [surprised] {sfx:squeak} ¡Piiip! Búho parpadeó. Lo intentó otra vez. ¡Piiip! [sad] Oh, no, dijo Búho. ¡Mi uuuh no sale! Ratón {mouse:hop} subió por el árbol. {tree:pulse} No te preocupes, dijo. Te presto el mío. ¡Piip-piip! Ciervo {deer:pulse} levantó su gran cabeza. Y el mío, dijo, muy grave. Mmmmm. Búho probó los dos a la vez. Piip-mmm. Ratón probó. Mmm-piip. Ciervo probó y sonó como un abejorro resfriado. {deer:wobble} [laughs] Búho empezó a reírse. Ratón se rio. Ciervo se rio tanto que el árbol {tree:wobble x2} sacudió las hojas. Y de en medio de la risa de Búho, grande, redondo y calentito, salió… {sfx:hoot} ¡UUUH! {owl:hop} {owl:sparkle} ¡Ahí está!, dijo Ratón. [softly] Estaba escondido detrás de una risa, dijo Ciervo. Y Búho ululó toda la noche, por si acaso.

squeak.prompt: a tiny high mouse squeak, short and comic

hoot.prompt: one big warm round owl hoot, close and friendly
